item.title: 'You never move on': Family of teen killed in hit-and-run speaks at driver's parole hearing
item.description: The family of a 13-year-old killed in a hit-and-run accident spoke today following the driver's parole hearing.

item.title: Utah launches single online portal for multiple state services
item.description: At the state capitol today, Governor Spencer Cox announced the launch of MyUtah.gov, a new, single online portal for multiple state services.

item.title: Utah legislators accept Ukrainian flag, reaffirm support for country
item.description: Governor Spencer Cox and other Utah legislative leaders accepted a flag from Ukraine's Kharkiv Regional Council today and spoke on Utah's support and dedication to help the people of Ukraine defend their land against Russia.

item.title: Lehi Police warn of AI kidnapping scam after scammers impersonate child and demand money
item.description: The Lehi City Police Department is warning residents of a new scam in which criminals use AI to make victims believe they have kidnapped a loved one and demand money.

item.title: Does a prepaid stamp count as paying voters to remove their signature? New GOP lawsuit against Better Boundaries thinks so
item.description: The GOP-backed group hoping to repeal Utah's anti-gerrymandering law, Proposition 4, has filed a lawsuit alleging that their opposition, Better Boundaries, violated state initiative laws by pre-paying for stamps on recission forms for voters.

item.title: Proposed tax bill would increase the price of a pack of cigarettes by $1.75
item.description: A bill that recently passed the House would increase the tax on multiple nicotine products in Utah, including raising the price of a pack of cigarettes by $1.75.

item.title: Community comes together to support local egg stand
item.description: An Enoch family who attempted to help their neighbors save money on eggs, after someone took advantage of their stand.

item.title: Utah Jazz players meet young fans at Primary Children's Hospital
item.description: Utah Jazz players visited with patients at the Intermountain Health Primary Children's Hospital Miller Family Campus.

item.title: One critically injured in rollover crash on I-15 near St. George
item.description: A crash on northbound I-15 near milepost four is leading to lane closures and delays near St. George and injuring one person.

item.title: Educators speak on Utah 'bell-to-bell' cell phone ban bill
item.description: A Utah bill that limits cell phones in schools may be signed into law during this legislative session and ABC4's Mckenzie Diaz spoke with educators on what that would mean for their students.
